title: CHGR shared reference definitions
description: Reference-tuple definitions for the CHGR schema family (Phase 143E). A valid reference proves shape only: it never implies the referenced artifact exists, is current, or is authoritative (CHGR-REQ-080, CHGR-REQ-089, CHGR-REQ-095) -- resolving and cross-checking a reference is a governance/verification.py responsibility. Independently defined from src/pcae/schema_resources/cltr_cutover/shared/references.schema.json per CHGR-001 Sec.16/Sec.19.1's no-composition-across-families rule.

record_id.description: Always present. The referenced CHGR artifact's own record_id.

record_digest.description: Always present. The referenced artifact's own record_digest at reference-authoring time, shape-checked only (CHGR-REQ-082).

record_family.description: Always present. Closed family tag preventing one artifact family from silently masquerading as another.

artifact_reference.description: Stable id+digest+family reference tuple. Does not verify the referenced artifact actually exists or matches the claimed family or current content (verification-layer responsibility).

template_reference.description: Pins an exact Decision Template identity and version (CHGR-REQ-088). A published record's template_ref never changes once set.
